name: nanomuse-desktop
description: NanoLika Desktop: the NanoLika desktop built on DeepSeek Harness. The harness's web app in a window of our own, with NanoLika's account, face, Hands and Reach as plugins and the runtime for the hands bundled.

scripts.test: node scripts/patch-file-type.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.dist: node scripts/patch-file-type.mjs && node scripts/prepare-plugin.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/prepare-node.mjs && node scripts/patch-dsh.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: node scripts/patch-file-type.mjs && node scripts/prepare-plugin.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/prepare-node.mjs && node scripts/patch-dsh.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --dir
